nodes.description: Public pure function validating a BubbleBudz id by checking the upper 96 bits against a fixed address and the low bits against 1.
Public pure function extracting the raw genesis id from tokenId_ via mask/shift and subtracting 2.
Input id_ passed to isValidBubbleBudz, inspected via shift and bitwise AND.
Input tokenId_ passed to bubbleBudsGenesisId, masked and shifted to extract the raw id.
Intermediate local _rawId holding the masked and shifted value derived from tokenId_.
Local _fixedId = _rawId - 2, the value returned by bubbleBudsGenesisId.
Bitwise shift (id_ >> 96) and mask (id_ & 0xffffffffff) comparisons used for validation.
Arithmetic operation _rawId - 2, which can underflow when the extracted raw id is less than 2.
Bitwise mask (tokenId_ & 0xffffff0000000000 style mask) and shift by 40 extracting the raw id.

edges.reason: Parameter id_ is the sole input consumed by isValidBubbleBudz.
Parameter tokenId_ is the sole input consumed by bubbleBudsGenesisId.
isValidBubbleBudz execution leads into the bitwise shift/mask validation operations.
id_ is shifted by 96 and bitwise-ANDed with a mask inside the validation checks.
bubbleBudsGenesisId execution leads into the mask and shift of tokenId_.
tokenId_ is masked and shifted by 40 to derive the raw genesis id.
Local _rawId is assigned from the masked/shifted value produced by the bitwise operation.
bubbleBudsGenesisId execution continues into the subtraction of 2.
_rawId feeds the subtraction _rawId - 2, which can underflow for raw ids below 2.
Local _fixedId is assigned the result of the subtraction _rawId - 2.
_fixedId is returned as the function result of bubbleBudsGenesisId.

normalization_plan.reason: id_ is only a transient input of isValidBubbleBudz and carries no independent semantic identity.
tokenId_ is only a transient input of bubbleBudsGenesisId and is fully absorbed by its computation.
_rawId exists solely to hold the masked and shifted output of the bitwise unsafe operation.
_fixedId exists solely to hold the result of the _rawId - 2 subtraction unsafe operation.
